title: XMimic and XSoma: Learning Humanoid Motion Tracking and Locomotion in Under a Minute
abstract: arXiv:2611.20452v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present XMimic and XSoma, which learn humanoid motion tracking and locomotion on rough terrain in under a minute of training. Both follow SuperMimic, which learns a world model of the robot and optimizes the policy with analytic gradients through short rollouts imagined in this model. Existing implementations of this method do not make use of larger GPUs, as every training iteration is a long chain of small GPU operations that run one after another. XMimic and XSoma therefore shorten this chain and run the steps of every iteration at the same time on up to four GPUs. We compile the complete training loop with JAX, including the MuJoCo Warp simulator. For locomotion, XSoma leaves only the dynamics of the robot to the world model and computes everything else exactly, including the terrain height under the feet. translated_title: XMimic与XSoma：在一分钟内学会人形机器人动作跟踪与运动控制
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.20452v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：我们提出了XMimic和XSoma，它们在不到一分钟的训练时间内学习人形机器人的动作跟踪以及粗糙地形上的运动控制。两者均遵循SuperMimic的思路，即学习机器人的世界模型，并在该模型中通过想象的短程推演，利用解析梯度来优化策略。该方法的现有实现未能充分利用大型GPU，因为每次训练迭代都是由许多小的GPU运算依次串行执行构成的长链条。因此，XMimic和XSoma缩短了这一链条，并在最多四块GPU上同时运行每次迭代的各个步骤。我们使用JAX编译了完整的训练循环，包括MuJoCo Warp模拟器。在运动控制方面，XSoma只将机器人的动力学交给世界模型处理，其余所有内容都精确计算，包括脚下地形的高度。它以一秒的时域范围进行学习，且不需要critic网络。在四块H100 GPU上，XMimic学会了跟踪全部40条LAFAN1动作片段（原文摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: XMimic和XSoma通过用JAX编译完整训练循环并在多块GPU上并行执行每次迭代的步骤，将人形机器人动作跟踪与粗糙地形运动控制的学习时间压缩到了一分钟以内。
en_tdlr: XMimic and XSoma compile the entire training loop with JAX and run each iteration's steps in parallel across up to four GPUs, learning humanoid motion tracking and rough-terrain locomotion in under a minute of training.
